executable.name: aichallenge_awsim_eval
executable.cmd: env __NV_PRIME_RENDER_OFFLOAD=$(var awsim_prime_render_offload) __VK_LAYER_NV_optimus=$(var awsim_vk_layer_optimus) VK_ICD_FILENAMES=$(var awsim_vk_icd_filenames) /aichallenge/simulator/AWSIM/AWSIM.x86_64 -force-vulkan --start-mode sync --vehicles $(var vehicles) --laps $(var laps) --timeout $(var timeout)
